phase: Phase C1-I - barycentric light time, Shapiro delay and TT interval conversion: production implementation and qualification
written: 2026-10-22, before any C1-I code or number
basis: studies/phase17/reports/phase_c1_light_time_materiality.md (IMPLEMENT: FRAME, SHAPIRO_SUN, SHAPIRO_EARTH, TIME_SCALE; DOCUMENT_ONLY: SHAPIRO_MOON, SHAPIRO_JUPITER; S4 adjudication owner-accepted 2026-10-22)

architecture.new_module: src/lunar_od/relativistic_light_time.py (new file, no frozen identity). Holds the light-time model configuration, the barycentric event solvers (two-way receive-tagged chain, one-way backward, one-way forward), the Shapiro delay, the TT interval conversion, and the observable values and analytic partials for two-way range, counted Doppler, delta-DOR and one-way range
architecture.model_config: LightTimeModel(frame='MOON'|'SSB', shapiro_bodies=() | ('SUN','EARTH') | ..., interval_time_scale='TDB'|'TT', ephemeris_two_cycle_tolerance_s=1e-11). The production default is the historical model: frame='MOON', no Shapiro, TDB; the DSN-faithful configuration is frame='SSB', shapiro_bodies=('SUN','EARTH'), interval_time_scale='TT'
architecture.frame_rule: an SSB endpoint = its Moon-centred position + the Moon's SSB position (SPICE, the loaded kernels) at that endpoint's own epoch; velocities likewise. Partials w.r.t. the spacecraft's Moon-centred state are unchanged in form; only the line of sight and the event-time sensitivities use the SSB geometry
architecture.untouched_production_modules: two_way_range.py, radiometrics.py, delta_dor.py, measurements.py, two_way_counted_doppler*.py keep their bytes (their own R2/R3 hash gates stay as they are). The new module imports their station-state providers and spacecraft interpolation read-only
architecture.estimator_integration: estimators.py dispatches the two-way range nominal values, residuals and initial-state Jacobian (BLS-LM and SRIF, six-state and K_SRP paths) to the new module when pass_geo.measurement_model_profile == 'two_way_light_time_ssb'; the profile and the LightTimeModel are set by the new module's measurement generator. Every other profile runs the existing code unchanged
architecture.re_freeze: estimators.py changes bytes; its path-migration identity must be re-frozen. OWNER AUTHORISATION IS REQUESTED BEFORE THAT COMMIT (not assumed by this predeclaration)
architecture.out_of_scope: scenarios.py / scenario JSON / desktop plumbing of the new model (a later step); SR-UKF two-way support (no current two-way UKF path); production counted-Doppler and delta-DOR estimators (these observables are delivered as values + partials for the study designs that already assemble them)

gates.G1_default_invariance: with no opt-in, every existing test passes and the full suite has no new failure relative to main on the same machine; the MOON default path never calls the new module
gates.G2_moon_mode_parity: the new module with LightTimeModel(frame='MOON') reproduces production on all 10 C1 cells: two-way range <= 1e-6 m, counted Doppler <= 1e-7 m/s, delta-DOR <= 1e-12 s (same thresholds as C1 S1-S3)
gates.G3_survey_parity: with frame='SSB' and each Shapiro body / the TT conversion switched on one at a time, the new module reproduces the C1 survey's independent per-term values on all 10 cells: range <= 1e-6 m, Doppler <= 1e-8 m/s, delta-DOR <= 1e-12 s
gates.G4_orekit: against Orekit (agent-sandbox/orekit-gmat-oracle harness, Canberra, 121 receive epochs, matched station states, DE440 for this gate only): barycentric two-way range <= 1 cm and counted Doppler <= 3 um/s (0.1 sigma at DSN-realistic noise); the Shapiro term compared where Orekit models it, otherwise reported against the closed form
gates.G5_jacobians: analytic partials vs central finite differences, best over a step sweep, max relative error: two-way range and delta-DOR <= 1e-6, counted Doppler <= 1e-5, on 3 cells x 20 rows each, in SSB mode with Shapiro and TT on
gates.G6_estimator_closure: BLS-LM and SRIF on noise-free SSB+Shapiro+TT truth with the SSB estimator recover the truth: |dr| <= 1 mm, |dv| <= 1e-6 m/s, status Converged (certified), on CANON k0 range-only six-state
gates.G7_bias_mapping_crosscheck: the MOON estimator on SSB+Shapiro+TT truth (CANON k0 range-only, noise-free, six-state + K) ends at a state offset whose sigma-normalised components agree with the C1 survey's linear bias mapping within 10 % (largest component) - validates the survey's OD numbers nonlinearly
gates.G8_record_boundary: the C1 S4 row (CANON k0 range row 821, SSB) returns a value with a flagged two-cycle <= 1e-11 s and no exception; any two-cycle above the tolerance raises a named error
gates.G9_ddor_jacobian_report: informational with a predeclared follow-up rule: R1O-D2 CANON Goldstone-Canberra f_perp recomputed with SSB delta-DOR Jacobians vs the authoritative 0.172343 (range + delta-DOR). If |delta f_perp| >= 0.01 or a class changes, a requalification phase for the delta-DOR science is opened; otherwise the authoritative status records the check

outcome_rule: C1I_NOT_QUALIFIED otherwise; failing gates reported as computed; the opt-in stays undocumented as production-ready until resolved
G9 never blocks the outcome; it decides only whether a delta-DOR requalification phase is opened
